card:Billing Software: Welcome. This is a quick demo of our multi-vendor billing software, with G S T invoices, an admin control panel, and a sales dashboard.
The admin signs in to the portal: The admin signs in to the portal.
First login: the admin must set a privat: On the very first login, the admin has to set a private password.
The admin adds a billing vendor (a clien: Now the admin adds a billing vendor. Each vendor is one of your clients.
A temporary password is shared with the: A temporary password is created, and shared with the vendor.
Vendor account created. The vendor must: The vendor account is ready. The vendor must change this password at their first login.
Admin can also customise the login-page: The admin can also customise the logo and name shown on the login page.
Now the vendor signs in with the details: Now the vendor signs in, using the details they received.
The vendor sets their own password: The vendor sets their own password.
Each vendor gets a private workspace: ow: Every vendor gets a private workspace, with their own data and their own branding.
Step 1: set up the company profile: Step one. Set up the company profile: address, phone, G S T number, and bank details.
Pick a brand colour. The whole app and e: Pick a brand colour. The whole app, and every invoice, follows it.
Step 2: add the items you sell, with the: Step two. Add the items you sell, with their price.
Step 3: create a GST invoice: Step three. Create a G S T invoice.
Pick an item and the price fills in auto: Just pick an item, and the price fills in automatically.
CGST / SGST and the total are calculated: C G S T, S G S T, and the total are calculated live.
The invoice is ready: logo, GST, amount: The invoice is ready, with the logo, G S T details, amount in words, and bank details.
Print or save as PDF with one click, the: Print it, or save it as a P D F with one click. When the money arrives, mark it as paid.
The dashboard shows sales month-wise and: The dashboard shows your sales, month wise and item wise.
Monthly sales: billed, GST, received and: Monthly sales: how much was billed, G S T, what is received, and what is still pending.
Item-wise sales with quantity and share: Item wise sales, with quantity sold and share of the total.
Item × Month grid: see how each item sel: And an item by month grid, to see how each item sells over time.
Works beautifully on mobile too: It works beautifully on mobile too.
Bottom menu for one-thumb use: A bottom menu makes it easy to use with one thumb.
Create a bill from your phone: And create a bill, right from your phone.
Back to the admin: sees every vendor at: Back to the admin, who sees every vendor at a glance.
Invoices, total billed and pending amoun: Number of invoices, total billed, and pending amount, for each vendor.
Open a vendor to view or support their b: The admin can open any vendor, to view or support their billing.
Disable access any time: the vendor is s: And access can be disabled at any time. The vendor is signed out instantly.
card:Thank you: Thank you. Your own branded billing portal, for every vendor.
